📢 URGENT JOB OPENING –CHARGES, PAYMENT POSTER & AR CALLER
🏢 Position: AR Caller – Medical Billing WFO only
📍 Location: Kellys, Ambattur, Ekkathuthangal Chennai
Kellys office only girls can apply
Ambattur and Ekkathuthangal both genders can apply 
Interview mode: Walk in
💼 Experience: 1–5Years
Payment max salary is 30k and 40 k for AR caller
🎓 Qualification: Any Degree / Relevant Medical Billing Qualification
🕐 Shift: Day shift for Charges and payments Night Shift for callers
💰 Salary: Based on experience and interview performance
Job Responsibilities
• Follow up with insurance companies regarding outstanding claims
• Handle denied, rejected, and pending claims
• Verify claim status and document follow-up details
• Identify payment issues and take appropriate action
• Meet daily productivity and quality targets
Skills Required
✅ Good communication skills
✅ Basic knowledge of US Healthcare / Medical Billing
✅ AR calling experience preferred
✅ Willingness to work in night shifts
📩 Interested candidates can share their updated resume.
📞 Contact:9942811477
